changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0068. Remember whether a connected Drive account should receive progress photos, and which folder is the destination. Index review: no new index; the existing unique tenant-provider index still loads the one connection. Performance note: the columns are read with the connection row already fetched for upload.

rollback.sql: IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.TenantStorageConnections', N'ProgressFolderName') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TenantStorageConnections DROP COLUMN ProgressFolderName;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.TenantStorageConnections', N'ProgressFolderId') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TenantStorageConnections DROP COLUMN ProgressFolderId;
IF OBJECT_ID(N'DF_TenantStorageConnections_StoreProgressPhotos', N'D') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TenantStorageConnections DROP CONSTRAINT DF_TenantStorageConnections_StoreProgressPhotos;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.TenantStorageConnections', N'StoreProgressPhotos') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.TenantStorageConnections DROP COLUMN StoreProgressPhotos;
